entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: This IE is included in messages when the network wishes to transmit protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events to the UE. It is used when extended protocol configuration options are supported by both the UE and the network end-to-end for the PDN connection.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options supported end-to-end
entities.description: Condition that both the UE and network support extended protocol configuration options end-to-end for the PDN connection.

entities.name: Network transmits protocol data to UE
entities.description: Property indicating the network wishes to transmit protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events to the UE.

relations.description: Inclusion of the extended protocol configuration options IE is guarded by the condition that both UE and network support it end-to-end for the PDN connection.
The network's need to transmit protocol data to the UE establishes the inclusion of the extended protocol configuration options IE in the message.
